parsed.post: Discarding the high MATRIX_LR (0.04) trial as it increased val_bpb to 0.88. Returning to the best configuration (0.840218). Next, I will attempt to fine-tune the learning rate slightly lower than 0.04 to find a more stable sweet spot for the current depth and batch size.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to find a more stable learning rate and potentially lower the val_bpb below 0.84.
